d:
Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh quoted poet Rahat Indori’s famous line, ‘Kisi ke baap ka Hindostan thodi hai’, during his concert in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore on November 15. The performance came amid objections over songs allegedly promoting alcohol consumption, last-minute police permissions and bomb threat emails that were later declared a hoax. Diljit also claimed that attempts had been made to stop his concert and took a dig at news channels over their coverage of the controversy.
Thank you for watching our video!
